title: Wild Cat Blues

title: Bleeding Hearted Blues
source: Internet Archive 78rpm collection item JV-621-1923-QmQavyrgUpzaFHKZPrV3bucALMTQaZdBk4eoVKZz5o434L.mp3
licence: Public domain in the US (sound recording published 1925 or earlier; composition published 1930 or earlier)
notes: Band set tune 2 of 4. Recorded Camden, New Jersey, July 1923 (Victor matrix B-28197, take 6; DAHR dates take 6 to 25 Jul 1923, the archive.org notes say 5 Jul); issued on Victor 19123, release date 15 Sep 1923 per DAHR from the Victor blue history card (https://adp.library.ucsb.edu/index.php/objects/refer/14076 ; matrix https://adp.library.ucsb.edu/index.php/matrix/refer/800002211). Composition by Lovie Austin (with Alberta Hunter), 1923: sheet music published by Jack Mills Inc., New York (copy in the Archives Center, National Museum of American History; the firm was renamed Mills Music in 1928, so this printing predates 1928), and DAHR's Columbia and OKeh entries for the song cite US Copyright Office files ('Lovey Austin'). Transfer: archive.org 320 kbps MP3 (already restored/denoised), uploader-marked CC0; the recording itself is PD-US. Processing: mono, 60 Hz high-pass, adeclick (threshold 4), afftdn nr 4 dB, trimmed 0.74-189.11 s with 150 ms in / 800 ms out fades, +3.04 dB then 4x-oversampled limiter at -2.4 dBTP to -16 LUFS. Opus 96 kbps / AAC 128 kbps.
